title: 형사소송비용 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 3 (Travel Expenses and Accommodation Expenses for Witnesses, etc.)
(1) "Other equivalent expenses" provided for in Article 4 (1) of the Act shall refer to meal expenses. <Amended on Sep. 13, 2003>
(2) Domestic travel expenses and accommodation expenses for witnesses, etc. under Articles 4 (2) and 5 (2) of the Act shall be the amounts payable to persons falling under category 2 of the Table of Domestic Travel Expense Payments in Attached Table 2 under Articles 10 (1), 11 (1), 12 (1), 13 (1), and 16 (1) of the Rules on Travel Expenses for Court Officials; in the case of railway fares, the proviso to Article 10 (1) of those Rules shall apply mutatis mutandis. <Amended on Jan. 9, 2009>
